trades.ask: Bring me a Gallopers Horse and I'll swap you Chapbook: Gust Nudge for it. I've read it twice and my knees have had enough.
trades.thanks: Lovely. That'll look grand on the sideboard. The pamphlet's yours, mind how you go.

trades.ask: Now then, my cupboard wants Whiting, two of them. I'll swap you a Sou'wester.
trades.thanks: Oh, you've saved me a trip. Here you are.

trades.ask: I'll swap you a Stick of Rock for 2 Leeks. It's been on the mantelpiece long enough.
trades.thanks: Go on then, it's yours. Look after it.

trades.ask: Now then, bring me Nettles, three of them and £610 is yours. Fair's fair.
